mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_message_retry SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, sku_id AS skuId, order_sn AS orderSn, message_body AS messageBody, status, retry_count AS retryCount, error_msg AS errorMsg, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modified AS gmtModified FROM seckill_message_retry WHERE status = 0 AND retry_count < #{maxRetries} ORDER BY gmt_create ASC LIMIT 50
